laboratori.abbondanza_poca: The album has {abbondanza} mm of bleed, the product “{nome}” asks for {richiesta}: create a new album with this product from the Albums screen
laboratori.almeno_un_prodotto: must have at least one product
laboratori.carattere_nome_file: contains a character that can't be in a file name ({caratteri})
laboratori.chiave_sconosciuta: is signed with a key that this version of Impaginatore doesn't know (no. {numero})
laboratori.data: must be a date as YYYY-MM-DD
laboratori.firma_incompleta: catalogue: incomplete signature (“id_firma”, a number, and “firma”, 128 hexadecimal digits are needed)
laboratori.firma_non_corrisponde: catalogue: the signature doesn't match the contents (the file was changed after signing): ask whoever gave it to you for a new copy
laboratori.firma_ritirata: catalogue: it is signed with a signing key that has been withdrawn: ask whoever gave it to you for a new copy
laboratori.firmato_dal_produttore: signed by the maker of Impaginatore
laboratori.formato_diverso: The album has pages of {larghezza} × {altezza} cm, the product “{nome}” of {w} × {h} cm: the size of an existing album can't be changed. Create a new album with this product from the Albums screen
laboratori.formato_piu_recente: is in a newer format than this version of Impaginatore: update the program
laboratori.generico: only the catalogues that come with the program are generic
laboratori.graffe: unclosed braces: braces are only for placeholders
laboratori.id_del_programma: “{id}” is the id of a catalogue that comes with the program: the lab must use another
laboratori.id_doppio: there is already a catalogue with the id “{id}”
laboratori.id_non_valido: {dove}: must be an identifier of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (at most 40)
laboratori.id_prodotti_doppi: the same id for more than one product: {ids}
laboratori.meno_abbondanza: the album has less bleed than the product asks for
laboratori.non_installato: this product's catalogue isn't installed on this computer
laboratori.non_trovato: Catalogue “{id}” not found: import it from the Albums screen
laboratori.prodotto_diverso: the product differs from the one in the installed catalogue (catalogue updated?)
laboratori.prodotto_non_valido: Invalid product: the catalogue and the product are needed (for example “generico/quadrato-30”)
laboratori.riepilogo_abbondanza: Bleed: {mm} mm per side, included in the files
laboratori.riepilogo_copertina: Cover (to be prepared separately, Impaginatore doesn't export it): {testo}
laboratori.riepilogo_da_confermare: WARNING: the specifications in this catalogue are TO BE CONFIRMED with the lab before printing
laboratori.riepilogo_file_pagine: Files: {formato} quality {qualita}, one per page · {px} px
laboratori.riepilogo_file_spread: Files: {formato} quality {qualita}, one per spread · {px} px
laboratori.riepilogo_filigrana: Free trial: the files carry a watermark and must not be printed
laboratori.riepilogo_sicurezza: Safe zone: {mm} mm from the edge
laboratori.riepilogo_spread_limiti: Spreads in the album: {n} (the product wants {limiti})
laboratori.segnaposto_sconosciuto: unknown placeholder “{segnaposto}”: the valid ones are {validi}
laboratori.senza_chiave: this copy of Impaginatore doesn't have the key to verify signatures (development build)
laboratori.senza_prodotto: The catalogue “{nome}” doesn't have the product “{prodotto}”
laboratori.serve_segnaposto: must contain {segnaposto}: every file needs a different name
laboratori.sicurezza_troppa: the safe zone covers the whole page
laboratori.troppo_grande: The catalogue is too large (at most {mb} MB)
laboratori.verificato_resta: The catalogue “{nome}” you have is verified, this one isn't ({motivo}): I won't replace it
